scenarios.recoveryAction: Restore both PostgreSQL clusters into new project-scoped volumes from the selected pgBackRest labels.
scenarios.expectedResult: Application and identity fingerprints exactly match the complete recovery-point catalog.

scenarios.recoveryAction: Restore every checksum-bound object version into a new project-scoped MinIO volume.
scenarios.expectedResult: The restored object fingerprint matches the immutable manifest and every restored byte count and SHA-256.

scenarios.recoveryAction: Reject a locally corrupted catalog before target mutation and select the preceding complete recovery point.
scenarios.expectedResult: The corrupt candidate cannot report success and the preceding complete point passes the full restore gate.

scenarios.recoveryAction: Restore an undelivered application outbox message and start the isolated worker.
scenarios.expectedResult: The isolated worker delivers the restored message through private Mailpit without changing the source stack.

scenarios.recoveryAction: Restart the isolated API node after restore and wait for dependency-aware readiness.
scenarios.expectedResult: Readiness returns HTTP 200 and the restored OIDC/TOTP browser smoke remains successful.
